title: FLAIR: Federated Learning Annotated Image Repository
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the model's classification performance (averaged precision) on a coarse-grained image class labeled 'religion', which was the least frequent class in the dataset.
findings: The 'religion' class, being the least frequent in the dataset, exhibited significantly lower classification performance compared to more common classes. This performance degradation was exacerbated in federated learning settings and became extremely poor under differential privacy, highlighting the challenge of learning from rare classes in distributed, private environments. For instance, in the fine-tuned private federated learning setting, the averaged precision for the 'religion' class was only 0.7, compared to 84.1 for the 'structure' class.
